author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live-stream excerpt Adam Savage shares his approach to interviewing fellow makers, putting nervous creators at ease on camera. Next, he recommends his favorite MythBusters episodes to introduce to kids (Hint: Diet Coke and Mentos!). Finally, Adam responds to a viewer struggling with insomnia and burnout, opening up about his own experiences with extreme stress during the peak of MythBusters production. Many thanks to Tested members truedadof2, bethcallahan and Gwen-Maker-of-Things for their support and questions! How do YOU manage stress?
